描述_EN: the object was probably created by a wealthy hobbyist; on one side a mark reads: 'beautiful object made for enjoyment in the qianlong era (1736-95)'. eight small peaches are moulded on the surface, making a total of nine, an auspicious number associated with long life. the gourd is mounted on a hardwood stand decorated with silver inlays, almost certainly contemporary. the emperor's mark of qianlong, shanwan, is moulded in low relief on one shoulder. the marks made by the five sections of the mould are still visible. it was used as a display piece. its peach shape was obtained by using a mould which would have restricted its growth. this moulded gourd is the largest and most elaborate gourd in the collection.
描述_ZN: the object was probably created by a wealthy hobbyist; on one side a mark reads: 'beautiful object made for enjoyment in the qianlong era (1736-95)'. 表面有8个小桃子，总共有9个，这是一个与长寿有关的吉祥数字。 葫芦被安装在一个硬木支架上，支架上装饰有银色的镶嵌物，几乎可以肯定是当代的。 肩部有低浮雕的乾隆年号 "山云"。 模具的五个部分留下的痕迹仍然可见。 它被作为一个展示品使用。 它的桃子形状是通过使用模具获得的，这将限制其生长。 这个模制的葫芦是藏品中最大和最精致的葫芦。
